name: TrollPadEx
tagline: 为 iPhone 带来更灵活的多任务、窗口与外接显示体验。
description: TrollPadEx 为 iPhone 提供 iPad 风格的多任务、应用切换与 Dock 控制。
支持 iOS 26 原生台前调度与 Windowed Apps，可独立选择 iPad 或 iPhone 应用切换器。
features: iPad 应用切换器开关，默认开启；iOS 16–18 台前调度要求开启
台前调度与 iOS 26 Windowed Apps
iOS 26 Allow Smaller Windows，允许更小的原生应用窗口
浮动 Dock、最近应用与 App 资源库控制
键盘、外接显示与横屏主屏幕选项
备用 Respring 按钮、社区入口及三语言设置
compatibility: 台前调度需 iOS 16 或更高版本
Windowed Apps 与 Allow Smaller Windows 仅限 iOS 26
usage: 安装后打开“设置”中的 TrollPadEx，按需开启功能。
iOS 16 通过控制中心切换多任务模式；iOS 17 及以上使用插件入口打开系统“多任务与手势”设置。
iOS 16–18 开启台前调度会开启 iPad 应用切换器；关闭切换器会选择分屏。更改后请按提示 Respring。iOS 15 独立选择，iOS 26 保持原有行为。
更改 iPad 应用切换器开关后需要 Respring。
iOS 26 可开启 Allow Smaller Windows；App 自行布局，过小窗口可能裁切内容。
无法从 Dock 或侧栏拖入应用时，可使用系统的“添加另一个窗口”菜单。
使用系统中文九宫格时，请关闭 Enable iPadOS Keyboard。

changes: 改善 iOS 16–18 的 iPhone 应用切换体验。
iOS 16–18 台前调度自动开启 iPad 应用切换器；关闭该切换器会退出台前调度并选择分屏。切换器变更需 Respring。
调整 iOS 17 的 iPhone 应用切换器兼容处理，恢复 App 最小化与 Dock 图标的系统动画路径。
修复 iOS 17 关闭 iPad 应用切换器后仍显示网格的问题，恢复 iPhone 卡片与切换动画。
修复 iOS 17 切换器停留后重新进入时的预览异常与模糊跳变，改善重复切换稳定性。
修复关闭 iPad 键盘后部分 App 无法选择系统中文九宫格的问题，改善键盘设置生效。
改善关闭 Dock 中 App 资源库入口的行为。
修复关闭 iPad 键盘后，部分 App 仍使用全键盘、无法选择系统中文九宫格的问题。
改善键盘设置在 App 中的生效与刷新。
支持 iOS 26 台前调度与 Windowed Apps，改善多窗口及应用切换稳定性。
新增独立 iPad 应用切换器和 Allow Smaller Windows 选项。
新增备用 Respring 按钮与社区入口，完善英、简中、繁中设置。
改善台前调度与新系统版本上的使用体验。

en.name: TrollPadEx
en.tagline: Bring more flexible multitasking, windowing, and external display experiences to iPhone.
description: TrollPadEx brings iPad-style multitasking, app switching and Dock controls to iPhone.
Supports native iOS 26 Stage Manager and Windowed Apps, with an independent choice of iPad or iPhone app switcher.
features: iPad App Switcher option, enabled by default and required by Stage Manager on iOS 16–18
Stage Manager and iOS 26 Windowed Apps
Allow Smaller Windows on iOS 26 for native app layout below the normal minimum
Floating Dock, recent apps and App Library controls
Keyboard, external display and landscape Home Screen options
Alternative Respring action, community links and three-language Settings
compatibility: Stage Manager requires iOS 16 or later
Windowed Apps and Allow Smaller Windows require iOS 26
usage: Open TrollPadEx in Settings after installation and enable the features you need.
On iOS 16, switch multitasking modes in Control Center. On iOS 17 or later, open the system Multitasking & Gestures page from TrollPadEx.
On iOS 16–18, Stage Manager enables iPad App Switcher; disabling the switcher selects Split View. Respring as prompted. iOS 15 keeps an independent choice; iOS 26 retains its existing behavior.
Respring after changing the iPad App Switcher option.
On iOS 26, enable Allow Smaller Windows if needed. Apps manage their layouts and may clip content in very small windows.
If dragging an app from the Dock or recent-app strip is unavailable, use the native Add Another Window menu.
For the system Chinese 9-Key keyboard, turn off Enable iPadOS Keyboard.

changes: Improved iPhone app switching on iOS 16–18.
On iOS 16–18, Stage Manager enables iPad App Switcher; turning it off selects Split View. Respring to apply switcher changes.
Adjusted iPhone App Switcher compatibility on iOS 17 to restore the system animation path for App minimization and Dock icons.
Fixed iOS 17 continuing to show a grid after disabling iPad App Switcher, restoring iPhone cards and transitions.
Fixed preview glitches and blur jumps when reopening the switcher after a pause on iOS 17, with improved repeated-switching stability.
Fixed the system Chinese 9-Key option being unavailable in some apps after disabling the iPad keyboard, and improved keyboard settings application.
Improved hiding the App Library entry when its Dock option is turned off.
Fixed some apps continuing to use a full keyboard and hiding the system Chinese 9-Key option after the iPad keyboard was disabled.
Improved how keyboard settings apply and refresh in apps.
Added iOS 26 Stage Manager and Windowed Apps support with improved multitasking and app-switching stability.
Added independent iPad App Switcher and Allow Smaller Windows options.
Added an alternative Respring action, community links and improved English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese Settings.
Improved Stage Manager and the experience on newer iOS versions.

en.notice: KillBackground13 may block in-app Dock gestures. If the Dock does not appear, temporarily disable KillBackground13 and respring before trying again.

notice: KillBackground13 可能阻止 App 内 Dock 手势。若 Dock 无法出现，请暂时停用 KillBackground13 并 Respring 后重试。
